notes.title: Optimize the animation effect and add some function options
notes.content:
1. The reader turns pages left and right to add animation effects
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38159096/67210ef9de505d31239ca7f001b3da6bd9e9e76b.gif[/img]
2. The animation effects of bookshelves and readers are optimized, the animation can be interrupted, and the effect is smoother

Set add options
1. Background settings add more options like custom color
2. Add color to the top title bar to add more options
3. Maximum number of top labels
4. The close button can choose to minimize or close the program directly
5. Whether the reader automatically jumps to the last closed page when opening a file
6. Reader image algorithm selection, good regional sampling image quality, and fast bilinear speed
7. Whether the reader uses animation effects to turn pages left and right
8. The reader can choose to turn pages from left to right or from right to left

notes.title: Reader update
notes.content:
This time the main update of the reader

1. Add a launcher
Support double-clicking the file to open
Under C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\ComicPictureShelf
CPLauncher.exe is the launcher
File associations can be set by setting the common settings

3. The software window has no border

4. Background settings

6. Other minor modifications
